periods.summary: Nene's wall-newspaper profile explains that her gravity ability can call down space debris with the forbidden Hadou Tensei, one of the most destructive Noble Arts known. During the Akatsuki crisis she and Kurono rush back from Osaka by running along the Shinkansen route after flights stop, then both sense Edelweiss's overwhelming sword aura. Nene reaches the mountain road in time to protect the unconscious Stella and the Hagure sisters, trading attacks with Ouma and forcing Reisen to withdraw Akatsuki. Afterward Stella asks Nene for help; Nene agrees only to a week of merciless training in which she will not teach, only beat Stella until she finds her own answer.
